about: The finisher camera for the cut (Dom 2026-10-27: the finishers were hard to READ on a phone, the foe small and low, the hero in front of the cut, only specks of red). PRESENTATION ONLY (the sim, the record and Gate 0 never see it; no slow-motion, no FOV change, no cut: V1's rule for finishers, docs/state/finishers.md, stays). Per finisher id: a late close side view of the cut, eased in on the finisher clock (0..1 over finisher-defs seconds / 0.75), on top of the row's push-in and side reveal in finisher-defs.json. `from`/`over`: finisher clock when it starts and how long it takes. `bone`: the foe's bone the cut is at (rig-bones names), followed live so the view tracks the ragdoll as it falls; a missing bone leaves the old push-in as it was. `mix`: how far the aim sits from that bone toward the foe's pelvis (0 = the cut, 1 = his middle), so the cut and the body that carries it both stay in a portrait frame. `angle`: radians the camera stands round the aim from the line to the hero, to the side the dolly already slides to, so the hero's shoulder is never between the lens and the cut. `dist`: metres from the aim (times his scale) and `span`: metres across the frame (times his scale), whichever stands further back. `rise`: metres the lens stands above the aim (times his scale), so the view looks down on the lying foe and the wound, never along the floor; `minEye` is its floor in metres. `blood`: `burst` multiplies the wound's spray rate, `pool` the floor stain's drawn width (exactly that factor). `stickBeatS`: seconds after the kill a held stick may not yet end the ceremony (data/respawn.json freeCamera.stickEndsCeremony ends it at once otherwise): the finisher's whole length, so the finisher camera plays for a player still holding the stick at the killing blow (Strategy 2026-10-27); a finisher with no row, and ?finishercam=v1, keep the immediate end. ?finishercam=v1 = the camera, blood and stick rule as they were before this row set.
